question: Computed _______ scan is a medical imaging technique that uses a computer-processed combination of multiple X-ray measurements taken from different angles to produce tomographic images of the body, allowing doctors to see inside the body without internal procedures.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tomography**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Computed Tomography** is a **method of medical imaging that uses a computer-processed combination of multiple X-ray measurements**
